final_topology.title: High-Frequency Trading Infrastructure
final_topology.description: Supports high-frequency trading with market data ingestion, processing, and order routing to three main sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a central data center for processing, connected to multiple exchange data feeds and three main sites for order execution. It ensures resilience and clear data flow.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n_new1) that manages the 'Asset Management System' (n35), which tracks assets across various zones and nodes.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes detailed data flow links (e.g., nl1, nl2, etc.) between various nodes and zones, indicating documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for different types of data processing and storage, such as 'Data Center' (z1), 'Non-Production' (z7), and 'Management' (z6).

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n5) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that manages security for various servers and workloads.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n16) and 'DNS Filter' (n17) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that manage DNS for the network.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'AAA Server' (n19) and 'Remote Access Management Service' (n_struct4) in the 'Remote Access' (z13) zone, indicating MFA for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n17) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that manages DNS filtering for the network.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n18) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that enforces URL filtering.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes a well-defined network architecture with separate zones for data processing, management, and non-production, indicating a secure design.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes secure management of network infrastructure, such as 'Infrastructure-as-Code' (IaC) and secure network protocols, indicated by the presence of 'Management Server' (n13) and 'AAA Server' (n19).

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a centralized 'AAA Server' (n19) in the 'Management' (z6) zone, indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Gateway' (n36) in the 'Remote Access' (z13) zone, which connects remote assets to the enterprise's AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Management' (z6) zone with 'Admin Workstation' (n20) and 'Management Server' (n13), indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative tasks.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' (n14) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that provides network intrusion detection.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n5) and 'NIPS' (n22) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that perform traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'AAA Server' (n19) and 'NAC' (n21) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that manage access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Log Collector' (n39) in the 'Log Collection' (z14) zone that collects network traffic flow logs from various nodes.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' (n22) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that provides network intrusion prevention.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' (n23) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that manages port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n24) in the 'Data Center' (z1) that performs application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Data Center' (z1) and 'Non-Production' (z7), indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Testing' (z11) zone with 'Penetration Testing Host' (n25) and 'Pen Test Manager' (n40), indicating the capability to perform periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z7 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes to indicate asset tracking.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show a VPN node or remote access connections to the AAA infrastructure.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit VPN node or remote access connections are shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a VPN node and links to the AAA server and remote access points.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show remote assets or their access control mechanisms.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit remote assets or access control mechanisms are shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add remote asset nodes and links to the AAA server to indicate access control.

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show a node or process for collecting network traffic flow logs.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit node or process for collecting network traffic flow logs is shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node for log collection and links to network devices.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a pen testing host (n25) and a pen testing security gateway (n_struct5), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests is shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or process for managing and scheduling periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not provide explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process. There is no node or link that indicates the maintenance of an asset inventory.
findings_before.missing_reason: No asset inventory system or process is represented in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links indicating the maintenance and review of the inventory.
